love-story-church-greenville-sc.assessment: Relentless Church is led by John Gray, who came from Joel Osteen's Lakewood Church — which is a significant yellow flag. Gray is a gifted communicator and charismatic personality but his doctrinal framework is unclear. Financial controversies, leadership disputes with the previous church (Redemption), and Lakewood-adjacent theology raise concerns. Not recommended without significant vetting. YELLOW — too many unknowns and the Lakewood pipeline is problematic. Renamed from Relentless Church effective March 31, 2024; John and Aventer Gray continue as Lead Pastor and Co-Pastor.
